prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Columbus Ohio for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” dentist for implants — the right provider depends on your needs (complexity of the case, esthetic goals, health, budget, insurance, location). For implants, you generally want a specialist with lots of implant experience: an oral & maxillofacial surgeon, a periodontist, or a prosthodontist (sometimes teams of these specialists work together).

How to find the best implant provider in Columbus, OH
- Start with specialists: search for board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeons (ABOMS), periodontists (AAP), and prosthodontists (ACP). Specialists handle surgical placement and/or restoration depending on their training.
- Check The Ohio State University College of Dentistry / OSU Wexner Medical Center — they have experienced faculty and specialists who do implants and complex cases.
- Use reputable review/credential sites: Google Business, Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Vitals, Yelp, and the professional directories above.
- Look for clinicians who use modern diagnostics (CBCT/3D imaging), digital planning, and offer implant brands you recognize (Nobel Biocare, Straumann, Zimmer/BioHorizons, etc.).
- Prefer practices that can manage the whole process (surgery + crown) or coordinate within a team — fewer handoffs usually give better outcomes.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants do you place per year? How many cases like mine?
- Are you board certified/what are your specialty credentials?
- Do you use CBCT 3D imaging and guided implant planning?
- What brand/type of implant do you use and why?
- What is the total cost (surgery, implant, abutment, crown, grafts, follow-ups)? What financing options are available?
- What sedation options and post-op support do you provide?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references for similar cases?
- What is your complication and success rate? What’s your warranty or policy for failures?

Typical experience and costs (approximate)
- Single dental implant (surgery + abutment + crown): often $2,000–$5,000+ depending on materials and whether bone grafting or sinus lift is required.
- Timeline: immediate to several months depending on healing, grafts, and whether immediate loading is possible.

If you’d like, I can:
- Search for top-reviewed implant specialists in Columbus and give you a short list (tell me a ZIP code or how far you want to travel).
- Draft a short list of questions you can use when calling or emailing clinics.

Which would you prefer?
